Monitoring: Field survey: if 4 nymphs or adults/m 2 for milky stage are found
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Use a sweep net for collecting nymphs and adult slender rice bugs and kill
Use hanging fermented meat around rice field to attract adult slender rice bugs and kill
Direct Control (Chemical): RD recommendation of insecticide dose, method and crop stages
